data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: When arbiter emits a DROP ruling, orchestrator writes a defense record with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter via review-defense-store.sh (locally) and review-github-defense-store.sh (CI); record shape conforms to contracts/review-defenses.md updated in S6
- DD3: Defense store readers are forward-compatible: a reader that doesn't know dropped_by_arbiter must ignore the record gracefully (not crash); this is verified by a test that feeds an unknown defense_type to the reader

## TDD Requirement
RED tests from Task e59d-a7e9-a4e4-47fc must FAIL before this task runs and PASS after.

Turn RED → GREEN:
- test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully: defense_store_load() must return the record without crashing when defense_type is an unknown value
- test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter: defense_store_write() must accept and persist a record with defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter"

## Implementation Notes

### plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh
1. Forward-compat reader changes in defense_store_load():
   - The existing reader uses python3 to parse DEFENSE_RECORD comments; it currently returns the record if prior_finding_id matches regardless of defense_type.
   - Verify that unknown defense_type values are NOT rejected by defense_store_load() — the current implementation may already be forward-compatible via pass-through.
   - If any code path rejects records with unrecognized defense_type fields, add a guard: parse defense_type as opaque string; never validate against an enum in the reader. Log a warning to stderr for unrecognized types but do NOT return "null" or exit non-zero.

2. defense_store_write() changes:
   - The existing validation does NOT validate defense_type field — verify this.
   - No changes needed to write if it already passes through unknown defense_type values.
   - If defense_type validation is added in S6 to enforce the new schema, ensure the reader side remains fail-open for unknown values per the Failure Contract in contracts/review-defenses.md: "arbiter_ruling.ruling contains an unrecognized value → Record stored as-is; arbiter ruling field treated as opaque by parsers that do not recognize the ruling value; a warning is logged."

3. Idempotency check (DD consideration):
   - Verify whether defense_store_write() has content-hash dedup. It does NOT currently (each call creates a new comment). Since the story asks for idempotent DROP write: add a content-hash dedup check in defense_store_write() when defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter":
   - Before writing, call defense_store_load(prior_finding_id) to check if a record with that prior_finding_id already exists AND has the same defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter". If so, skip the write and return the existing record on stdout (idempotent).
   - This is scoped ONLY to defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter to avoid disrupting the normal defense write path.

### plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh
- github_defense_store_write(): currently does NOT validate defense_type. Verify it passes through the field verbatim.
- No changes needed if it already passes through; verify via grep.
- If changes are needed: same forward-compat rule — unknown defense_type is stored as-is; warn but do not reject.

### contracts/review-defenses.md (read-only for this story — updated in S6)
- This story's implementation must conform to whatever S6 updates in the contract. Since S6 is a dependency, read the final version of the contract before implementing.
- Key contract rule from the Failure Contract table: "arbiter_ruling.ruling contains an unrecognized value — Record stored as-is; arbiter ruling field treated as opaque"

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh: modify (add idempotent dedup for dropped_by_arbiter + forward-compat reader guard)
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh: verify (may be no-op if already forward-compatible)
- tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh: turn RED → GREEN

## Pattern Reference
Existing defense_store_write() idempotency pattern does not exist. Closest prior art for content-hash dedup:
# from plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh:21-26
_defense_compute_fingerprint() {
    local content="$1" path="$2" lineno="$3"
    local collapsed
    collapsed=$(printf '%s' "$content" | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //;s/ $//')
    printf '%s:%s:%s' "$path" "$lineno" "$collapsed" | $_DSO_HASH_CMD | cut -c1-64
}
Use the existing _defense_compute_fingerprint helper to hash the prior_finding_id+defense_type for idempotency check.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] RED tests now PASS: test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] defense_store_load() does not crash on unknown defense_type (reader forward-compat confirmed)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | grep -v "^FAIL:" | grep -q "test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully"
- [ ] defense_store_write() with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter persists the record (write confirmed)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | grep -v "^FAIL:" | grep -q "test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter"
- [ ] Idempotent DROP write: calling defense_store_write() twice with same prior_finding_id + defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter does not create two DEFENSE_RECORD comments
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] Existing defense store tests still pass
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-ticket-binding.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add dropped_by_arbiter write + forward-compat reader to defense stores
